definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly between the 40s and 60s. Used as a loanword from English, particularly in lifestyle, health, and marketing contexts to refer to this demographic group or life stage.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジ{向|む}けの{雑誌|ざっし}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Magazines aimed at the middle-aged are increasing.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジになると{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}が{大切|たいせつ}になる。
examples.english: When you reach middle age, health management becomes important.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジの{男性|だんせい}をターゲットにした{新|あたら}しいファッションブランドが{話題|わだい}になっている。
examples.english: A new fashion brand targeting middle-aged men is generating buzz.

notes:
English loanword from "middle age." In Japanese, this term has a somewhat trendier, more modern feel than the native {中年|ちゅうねん}, and is often used in marketing, media, and lifestyle contexts. It can sound softer or more positive than {中年|ちゅうねん}, which some people find less flattering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミドルエイジ{向|む}け: aimed at middle-aged people
- ミドルエイジ{世代|せだい}: the middle-age generation
- ミドルエイジの{危機|きき}: midlife crisis
- ミドルエイジ{男性|だんせい}/{女性|じょせい}: middle-aged men/women

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中年|ちゅうねん}: middle age — the standard Japanese term; can carry a slightly negative or plain nuance
- {壮年|そうねん}: prime of life — more formal, often implies vigor and capability
- シニア: senior — the next life stage, generally 60s and above
